subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose a provider-level retry config now, remove retry and land only the timeoutMs work, or wait for the canonical LLM retry/backoff design?
rationale: The retry half adds public config surface and fallback expectations, which automation cannot settle because repository policy treats provider routing and config/default additions as compatibility-sensitive product/API direction.

options.title: Split Retry Out
options.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and keep retry design on the canonical tracker while reviewing a focused timeoutMs patch.

options.title: Implement Retry Fully
options.body: Wire provider retry into model calls with retryable error classification, fallback ordering, docs/baseline updates, upgrade behavior, and focused runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers settle the public retry/backoff contract on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49376.

recommendation.title: Split Retry Out
recommendation.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and keep retry design on the canonical tracker while reviewing a focused timeoutMs patch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest visible routing owner for the config/API decision because prior related issue review already framed the public timeout/config direction and Peter Steinberger appears in adjacent config/runtime history.
